commands.name: commit
commands.description: Review and commit the current changes
commands.prompt: Inspect git status and diff in the current directory. Stage the relevant changes, write a clear commit message in the repository's existing style, and create the commit. Do not push and do not touch unrelated files.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review uncommitted changes for bugs and risks
commands.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes in this directory. Look for correctness issues, regressions, security problems, and missing tests. Report findings with file and line references. Do not modify files.

commands.name: tests
commands.prompt: Detect the project's test command and run the tests relevant to the current changes. Summarize failures and their likely causes. Do not modify files.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Fix the current build or test failures
commands.prompt: Run the build and tests, identify the failure, implement the smallest correct fix, and re-run the checks. Do not commit.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain the project and its entry points
commands.prompt: Explain the structure and purpose of the project in the current directory. Cover the main entry points, important modules, and how to run it. Be concise and use file references.

commands.name: pr
commands.description: Draft a pull request description for this branch
commands.prompt: Inspect the commits on the current branch relative to the default branch. Write a concise pull request title and description with a summary and a test plan. Do not push or open a pull request.
